vulnerability.name: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
vulnerability.description: picomatch <=4.0.7 ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs (build-time devDependency only; no >4.0.7 upstream release published on npm as of 2026-11-18)

statements.impact_statement: picomatch is strictly a build-time devDependency of Vite/@preact/preset-vite; it is absent from dist/ browser bundles (npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 vulnerabilities) and only evaluates static developer-authored glob patterns in repo scripts.
